A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LE-MMSE research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v1 reports original network-training experiments, reconstruction comparisons, and sensitivity analyses on FFHQ, CIFAR10, and FashionMNIST in Section 4 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds fastMRI reconstruction, FFHQ-128 experiments, and SSIM/LPIPS results.

M1.justification: The core analytic estimators remain unchanged, but Appendix C.2 removes batch normalization from the specified ResNet residual block. This is a limited architecture-specification revision; the PDFs do not establish whether it reflects a changed implementation or correction of the earlier description.

E1.justification: Section 4.6 adds fastMRI knee single-coil data and accelerated MRI reconstruction, introducing a medical-imaging domain and subsampled Fourier measurements beyond v1's denoising, inpainting, and deconvolution coverage. The existing datasets and tasks are retained.

E2.justification: The retained comparisons continue to evaluate UNet2D, ResNet, and PatchMLP; the new experiments reuse ResNet. Non-local means is newly discussed but is not evaluated as an additional baseline.

E3.justification: v2 adds SSIM/LPIPS evaluations, a 25%-sampled Fourier MRI protocol, and FFHQ-128 experiments using 3,000 images. Appendix C.4 changes the stated inpainting pre-inverse from B=A+ to B=A+ + 10^-5 I, while C.2 revises the ResNet block specification. These reported setting changes do not establish that retained experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The patch-size, noise, dataset-size, smoothing, mass-concentration, patchwork, and out-of-distribution analyses are retained in Section 4 and Appendix D. The added benchmark and metric results do not introduce a separate ablation, robustness question, or error analysis.

E5.justification: Section 4.4 newly specifies that the smoothed estimator's expectation is approximated using 50 Monte Carlo samples. This discloses sampling information without establishing increased repetitions. Existing median/IQR and standard-deviation reporting, including Figure 4's 50 noise realizations, is retained.

E6.justification: v2 adds fastMRI alignment results in Table 3, FFHQ-128 results in Table 6, and SSIM/LPIPS results in Figure 14. MRI test PSNR between ResNet and LE-MMSE ranges from 28.66 to 30.40 dB. The original Table 2 values and matched appendix plots are unchanged; these are additional results, not same-setting performance gains.

T1.justification: Corollary 3.7 and Appendix B.2 now assume invertible A and B for the necessity direction, rather than claiming that weight equality implies invertibility. Appendix B.3 corrects a patch index in a Gaussian mean, and Section 4.4 corrects the smoothing formula's LE-MMSE subscript. The principal derivations and proofs are retained.

C1.justification: v2 adds an explicit contribution interpreting CNNs as structured, data-adaptive generalizations of classical non-local means. It also narrows the introductory nonlinear extension statement to the analytical formulas. The central claims about constrained MMSE, patch recombination, and agreement with trained CNNs remain.

C2.justification: Section 3.4 newly explains the non-local-means connection through using training-set patches instead of input-image patches. Section 5.2 qualifies transformer permutation equivariance as applying without positional embeddings. Existing explanations of low-density failures, noise amplification, and generalization are retained.

D1.justification: v2 specifies the inpainting regularization magnitude and smoothing sample count, states that rank-deficient estimators are implemented, and clarifies that mass accumulation remains exact despite retaining only the nearest patches for concentration analysis. It supplies some settings for the new experiments; the existing code link, hardware, and general training recipe remain.

R1.justification: v2 adds Buades et al. (2005) for the non-local-means connection and Zbontar et al. (2018) for fastMRI. The earlier related-work discussion and primary novelty positioning are largely retained. Federer and Rao bibliography revisions concern already-cited works.

P1.justification: v2 adds Sections 4.6 and D.9, a short metric discussion, an impact statement, and expanded acknowledgements. It also edits notation explanations, contribution wording, affiliations, and publication information. Most existing prose and the overall section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds MRI and FFHQ-128 comparison grids, SSIM/LPIPS heatmaps, and two result tables: Figures 10, 14, and 30 and Tables 3 and 6. Existing displays are retained with renumbering, relocation, smaller captions, and page reflow; there is no extensive redesign.

improvement.justification: v2 strengthens support for the framework through Fourier MRI validation and perceptual agreement metrics, while the narrowed Corollary 3.7 assumptions and added numerical details improve precision. These are useful, limited gains over the retained theory and evidence. Reproducibility remains imperfect: Appendix D.9 points to Table 5's UNet2D configuration for its ResNet experiment.
